title: 第6章 天子守国门
content_zh:
第6章天子守国门
姚广孝兴入宫。
他既是永乐皇帝的心腹，却又是僧人，有着这双重的身份，使他出入宫禁反而比寻常大臣要便利。
永乐皇帝今日摆驾文楼，刚刚结束了经筵。
很明显，对于经筵，朱棣很不满意，他不悦的模样，听闻姚广孝觐见，宣他进入文楼之后，便冷哼一声：“诸大臣言必称以身为教，而示民之可从；以道为治，而化民之弗率……这般的屁话…”
姚广孝却是贸然地打断朱棣道：“陛下，贫僧刚从胡俨家中回来。”
朱棣道：“如何？”
“贫僧小试牛刀。”
“嗯？”
说罢，姚广孝将自己在学堂的事说了一遍，随后，随来的宦官便抱着一叠‘奏疏’进来。
朱棣勉强笑了笑：“收拾几个竖子而已，何须这样大费周章。”
姚广孝笑而不语。
朱棣道：“也好，那就一起来看看，这些竖子到底有几分见识。”
无论是朱棣，还是姚广孝，对此都没有过高的预期，一群少年能写出什么真知灼见来？
这些‘奏疏’和他们所想的一样，绝大多数都是味同嚼蜡，丝毫勾不起朱棣和姚广孝的兴趣。
因此，君臣二人一面有一搭没一搭的捡起奏疏看，一面闲聊：“申饬太子的旨意发出了吗？”
“应当发出了。”
朱棣别有深意地抬头看了姚广孝一眼。
应当二字很有玄机。
言外之意是……这件事不是姚广孝经手的，他也没有过问这件事。

朱棣收回目光，颔首要点头，却在下一刻，突然破口大骂：“满篇废话，这小子脑子里塞的是什么？稻草吗？”
姚广孝瞥了一眼，却是朱勇的奏疏。
朱棣脸色铁青，却还是忍住，接下来翻开下一本奏疏，再一看，眼睛都直了，胡子开始乱颤。
姚广孝：“……”
这一篇奏疏更是神奇，居然是一片空白。
只有两个字……张軏！
朱棣破防了。
他脸上微微胀红，胸膛起伏着，竟是一句话都说不出来。
姚广孝此时竟也是无言。
可片刻之后，朱棣虎目之中居然隐隐蒙上了一层雾，终究……一滴液体夺眶而出。
朱棣吸了吸鼻子，这个曾在乱军之中杀的血流成河也从未变色的人，居然老泪纵横。
朱棣用长袖掩面，哽咽道：“当年世美（张玉字）是何等的好汉，怎么就生出了这么一个狗东西，他若在天有灵，知道子嗣不堪到这个地步，定会责怪朕没有看顾好张家……虎父犬子，虎父犬子啊！“
姚广孝道：“陛下节哀，毕竟还是个孩子。”
”小小年纪就已这般，长大了还了得？”朱棣咬牙切齿，擦拭了涕泪，怒气冲冲道：“他父亲当初为了救朕，闯入敌军阵中，力竭战死。朕不能对不起他，张軏这竖子缺乏管教，朕就亲自管教。”
随即指着御案上散落的奏疏，忍不住大骂：“看看这些人……可有一个有出息的吗？他们的父兄，哪一个不是人中龙凤，可见平日里对他们的管教废弛到了何等的地步！”
说着，又捡起其中一份奏疏，为……大明国祚之要，在于迁都……”
念到了这里……
一下子，朱棣突然觉得有些不对劲了。
这本是随手捡起来的一份奏疏，可开头天子守国门五个字，却一下子直击朱棣和姚广孝的内心深处。
君臣二人不禁面面相觑，一时间瞠目结舌。

尤其是姚广孝，神色极为凝重，他沉吟片刻，才道：“陛下，此子……怎知此事？”
朱棣也已收了眼泪，姚广孝这句话，就很有名堂了。
什么是天子守国门，那就是迁都北平。
为何要迁都北平？历史上曾有人说因为朱棣曾经被封燕王，驻地就在北平，所以对北平有感情。
当然，这绝不是真正的原因。
根本的原因就在于，像朱棣这样雄才大略之人，当然清楚当今天下最大的弊病在哪里。
大明虽然一统天下，可是腹心之患永远都在北方，北方的游牧民族虽然遭受了重创，可是实力依旧不容小觑。
那么这个时候，整个大明就陷入了一个可怕的局面，要防备北方，必然要云集精锐大军。
而南京到辽东以及燕云一线足足上千里，皇帝对军队鞭长莫及，现在这些边军尚且可以控制，可说假以时日，难保不会出现唐朝后期藩镇林立的局面。
当然，到了宋朝的时候，为了防止边军坐大，倒是想到了一个好办法，那就是强干弱枝，也就是将天下最精锐的兵马编练为禁军，统统派驻京城驻扎，都在皇帝老子的眼皮子底下，也就不存在骄兵悍将的问题了。
而这样的弊病也是极大的，天下精兵都跑去了京城驻扎，边镇的实力肯定不足，于是乎，辽金和蒙古人崛起，而大宋朝廷，却不得不一味的对他们采取妥协退让，天下一统的局面付之一炬。
朱棣久在边镇，当然清楚将来大明一定会遭遇这个问题，而且这个问题几乎无解。
要嘛放任边军坐大，要嘛放弃大明的边防，无论是唐朝还是宋朝的军制，都让他无法接受。
靖难成功之后，朱棣和姚广孝二人曾对这个问题有过讨论。
最终姚广孝提出了迁都北平的战略。
只要迁都北京，那么天下的精兵就可以布置在北平一线，这些兵将既在皇帝的眼皮子底下，不担心出现藩镇割据的局面，与此同时，北平本来就是边镇，一旦有北方蛮族入侵，这天下的精兵既是拱卫皇帝的禁军，同时也是驻防边关的边军，可谓是一箭双雕。
朱棣其实在这个时候，已经下定了迁都的决心。
只不过……
朱棣手里拿着奏疏，依旧还在沉眉思索，因为新的问题又出现了。
迁都事关重大，一旦开始迁都，不但要耗费无数的钱粮，更重要的是，皇帝去了北平，那么文武百官也要随之迁徙。

可这文武百官，还有无数勋贵大臣们，可都已经在南京城安居乐业，更不必说，相比于这繁华的金陵，北平几乎可以算是苦寒之地了。
而这个时候，朱棣刚刚登基不久，人心未定，此时若是提出迁都，只怕要天下大乱不可。
所以朱棣和姚广孝最终采取的策略是，这件事不能急，而且此事必须保密，绝不能透出一点风声，这天下真正有这个想法的，只有朱棣和姚广孝二人，绝不能传至第三人的耳朵里。
可现在……一个少年，居然上了这样的奏疏。
姚广孝看着朱棣，眼里似乎带着疑窦，仿佛在说，陛下是不是将此事泄露出去了？
朱棣也同样用狐疑的眼神看向姚广孝。
可转瞬之间，二人却都放下了疑心，因为他们彼此是了解的，他们都是行事慎重的人，而且事关重大，绝不会泄露出只言片语。
朱棣道：“难道是这小子……自己想出来的？”
姚广孝则问：“此人是谁？”
朱棣低头一看落款，又是瞠目结舌。
他缓缓道出一个名字：“张安世……张安世是不是……是不是那……”
姚广孝清咳一声：“陛下所言的，莫非是太子殿下的妻弟……”
朱棣又垂头去看奏疏，奏疏里不但提出了天子守国门，而且将这理由说的一清二楚。
朱棣忍不住道：“此人的字写的似狗爬一般，只是行文条理却甚是清晰，一个这样的浑小子，竟有此见识，他不是恶贯满盈吗？”
话说到了这份上，姚广孝想了想道：“陛下，百闻不如一见，市井流言，不足为信。只是……此事该如何善了？”
是啊，本来是一个摸底，结果摸出了一条大鱼。
朱棣背着手，他拧着眉，突然龇牙冷笑道：“一个这样的小子，不该有此见识，难道是太子……”
姚广孝听罢，顿时露出喜色：“那么，贫僧就要恭喜陛下了。”
朱棣听罢，也觉得大感宽慰。
他不喜欢太子，一方面是太子过于肥胖，不似人君，另一方面则是他认为太子喜欢和一群腐儒厮混一起，满口仁义，这样的人……可以做一个读书人，但是绝不会是一个好皇帝。

做皇帝的，怎可妇人之仁？
可若当真这和太子的教诲有关的话，太子竟有这样的战略眼光，就难免教人刮目相看了。
只见朱棣摆摆手道：“此事，不必继续过问了，再过问，难免天下要传出迁都的传言，现在还不是时候，这些事，朕知，你知，太子知心照不宣即可。”
说罢，朱棣又禁不住露出怒容，愤愤不平地道：“其他的子弟，朕看都是混账，在里头寻几个特别混账的，给朕狠狠收拾，尤其是那张軏，朕不代他老子打断他的腿，意实难平！“
”真打？“
朱棣板着脸道：“打！”
二人计议定了，姚广孝冷不丁地道：“陛下是不是忘了，不久之前，陛下有一份旨意，申饬……太子殿下……”
朱棣的脸色骤然僵住了。
content_en:
Chapter 6 The Emperor Guards the Country
Yao Guang Xiaoxing entered the palace.
He was both a confidant of Emperor Yongle and a monk. His dual identity made it easier for him to enter and leave the palace than ordinary ministers.
Emperor Yongle was sitting in the Wenlou today and had just finished the sutra banquet.
It was obvious that Zhu Di was very dissatisfied with the Jingyan. He looked displeased. After hearing that Yao Guangxiao had come to see him and announced that he had entered the literary building, he snorted coldly: "The ministers must say that they use their bodies to teach and show the people what to follow; they use Tao as their rule and change the people's indiscretion... Such nonsense..."
Yao Guangxiao interrupted Zhu Di rashly and said, "Your Majesty, this poor monk just came back from Hu Yan's house."
Zhu Di said: "How?"
"The poor monk is trying his best."
"Huh?"
After that, Yao Guangxiao told what happened in the school, and then the eunuch who followed him came in with a stack of memorials.
Zhu Di forced a smile: "It's just a matter of cleaning up a few things, why bother with so much trouble."
Yao Guangxiao smiled and said nothing.
Zhu Di said: "Okay, let's see together how knowledgeable these Zhu Zi are."
Neither Zhu Di nor Yao Guangxiao had high expectations for this. What insights could a group of teenagers write?
These memorials were just as they thought, most of them were of the same taste and did not interest Zhu Di and Yao Guangxiao at all.
Therefore, the monarch and his ministers picked up the memorials and read them one after another, while chatting: "Has the decree to warn the prince been sent out?"
"It should be sent out."
Zhu Di looked up at Yao Guangxiao with a meaningful look.
The word "should" is very mysterious.
The implication is... Yao Guangxiao was not involved in this matter, and he did not have any involvement in it.
Zhu Di withdrew his gaze, nodded his head, but at the next moment, he suddenly cursed: "It's full of nonsense, what is this kid stuffed in his head? Straw?"
Yao Guangxiao glanced at it, but it was Zhu Yong's memorial.
Zhu Di's face turned livid, but he still held it back. Then he opened the next memorial. When he looked at it again, his eyes widened and his beard began to tremble.
Yao Guangxiao: "..."
This memorial is even more magical, it is completely blank.
There are only two words... Zhang Fu!
Zhu Di broke his guard.
His face was slightly red, his chest was heaving, and he was unable to say a word.
Yao Guangxiao was speechless at this time.
But after a moment, Zhu Di's eyes were covered with a layer of fog, and finally...a drop of liquid came out of his eyes.
Zhu Di sniffed. This man who had been killed in the rebel army and shed a lot of blood and never changed his color was actually crying all the time.
Zhu Di covered his face with his long sleeves and choked with sobs: "Shimei (Zhang Yuzi) was such a good man back then, how could he give birth to such a piece of shit? If he had a spirit in heaven and knew that his heir was in this bad state, he would definitely blame me for not taking good care of the Zhang family...a tiger father and a dog son, a tiger father a dog son!"
Yao Guang Xiao said: "Your Majesty, I express my condolences. After all, I am still a child."
"You're like this at a young age, how can you handle it when you grow up?" Zhu Di gritted his teeth, wiped his tears, and said angrily: "His father broke into the enemy's formation and died fighting to save me. I can't be sorry for him. Zhang Fu lacks discipline, so I will discipline him myself."
Then he pointed at the memorials scattered on the imperial case and couldn't help but curse: "Look at these people... can any of them be promising? Their father and brother are among the best. This shows how lax the discipline of them is in daily life!"
As he said that, he picked up one of the memorials again, saying...the key to the Ming Dynasty was to move the capital..."
After reading this...
All of a sudden, Zhu Di suddenly felt that something was wrong.
This was a memorial I picked up casually, but the five words at the beginning, "The Emperor Guards the Nation," struck straight into the hearts of Zhu Di and Yao Guangxiao.
The monarch and his ministers couldn't help but look at each other, dumbfounded for a moment.
Especially Yao Guangxiao, whose expression was extremely serious.After groaning for a moment, he said: "Your Majesty, how does this son... know about this?"
Zhu Di has also put away his tears. Yao Guangxiao's words are very famous.
What is meant by the emperor guarding the country is moving the capital to Peking.
Why move the capital to Peking? In history, some people once said that because Zhu Di was once named King of Yan and was based in Peiping, he had feelings for Peiping.
Of course, this is never the real reason.
The fundamental reason is that a talented and strategic person like Zhu Di certainly knows what the biggest shortcomings of the world are today.
Although the Ming Dynasty ruled the world, its innermost worries were always in the north. Although the nomads in the north suffered heavy losses, their strength should not be underestimated.
So at this time, the entire Ming Dynasty fell into a terrible situation. To defend against the north, it was necessary to gather elite troops.
The line from Nanjing to Liaodong and Yanyun was thousands of miles long, and the emperor was beyond the reach of the army. Now these border troops can still be controlled, but given time, it is difficult to guarantee that there will not be a situation where there will be many vassal towns in the late Tang Dynasty.
Of course, in the Song Dynasty, in order to prevent the frontier troops from getting bigger, they thought of a good way, that is, to strengthen the weak branches, that is, to train the most elite soldiers and horses in the world into the forbidden army, and station them all in the capital. They are all under the eyes of the emperor, so there is no problem of arrogant soldiers and strong generals.
And this kind of disadvantage is also huge. All the best soldiers in the world have gone to the capital to garrison, and the strength of the border towns is definitely insufficient. Therefore, the Liao, Jin and Mongols rose, but the Song Dynasty court had to blindly compromise with them, and the situation of unification of the world was in ruins.
Zhu Di has been in the border town for a long time, and of course he knows that Ming Dynasty will definitely encounter this problem in the future, and there is almost no solution to this problem.
Either let the border army grow stronger or give up the Ming Dynasty's border defense. Whether it was the military system of the Tang Dynasty or the Song Dynasty, he could not accept it.
After the success of Jingnan, Zhu Di and Yao Guangxiao discussed this issue.
Finally, Yao Guangxiao proposed the strategy of moving the capital to Peking.
As long as the capital is moved to Beijing, the world's elite soldiers can be deployed on the front line of Peiping. These soldiers will be under the emperor's nose and will not worry about the separatist situation of vassal towns. At the same time, Beiping is originally a border town. Once the northern barbarians invade, the world's elite soldiers will not only protect the emperor's imperial army, but also be the frontier troops stationed at the border. It can be said that it kills two birds with one stone.
In fact, Zhu Di had already made up his mind to move the capital at this time.
It's just...
Zhu Di held the memorial in his hand, still thinking deeply, because a new problem appeared again.
Moving the capital is of great importance. Once the capital is moved, not only will it cost countless money and food, but more importantly, if the emperor goes to Peiping, all civil and military officials will also move with him.
But these civil and military officials, as well as countless noble ministers, have all settled down in Nanjing. Not to mention, compared to the prosperous Jinling, Peiping can almost be regarded as a bitter cold place.
At this time, Zhu Di had just ascended the throne, and people were still undecided. If he proposed to move the capital at this time, he would probably cause chaos in the world.
Therefore, the final strategy adopted by Zhu Di and Yao Guangxiao was that the matter could not be rushed, and the matter must be kept secret, and no rumors could be allowed to leak. The only people in the world who really had this idea were Zhu Di and Yao Guangxiao, and it must not be spread to the ears of a third person.
But now...a young man has actually received such a memorial.
Yao Guangxiao looked at Zhu Di with suspicion in his eyes, as if to say, did your majesty leak this matter?
Zhu Di also looked at Yao Guangxiao with suspicious eyes.
But in an instant, both of them dropped their suspicions, because they knew each other, they were both cautious people, and the matter was so important that they would never leak a word.
Zhu Di said: "Did this kid... come up with it on his own?"
Yao Guangxiao asked: "Who is this person?"
Zhu Di lowered his head and looked at the signature, and it wasJaw-dropping.
He slowly said a name: "Zhang Anshi...Is Zhang Anshi...is that..."
Yao Guangxiao coughed: "Could it be that what your Majesty is talking about is His Royal Highness the Crown Prince's brother-in-law..."
Zhu Di lowered his head to read the memorial again. The memorial not only proposed that the emperor should guard the country, but also made the reason clear.
Zhu Di couldn't help but said: "This person's handwriting is like a dog crawling, but his writing is very clear. Such a stupid boy has such knowledge. Isn't he full of evil?"
When it came to this topic, Yao Guangxiao thought for a while and said: "Your Majesty, hearing is better than seeing. Rumors in the market are not trustworthy. But... how should this matter be resolved?"
Yes, it was originally a fishing trip, but in the end I found a big fish.
Zhu Di put his hands behind his back, frowned, and suddenly bared his teeth and sneered: "A boy like this shouldn't have such knowledge. Could he be a prince..."
After hearing this, Yao Guangxiao suddenly showed joy: "Then, I will congratulate Your Majesty."
After Zhu Di heard this, he felt greatly relieved.
He doesn't like the prince. On the one hand, the prince is too fat and not like a human king. On the other hand, he thinks that the prince likes to hang out with a group of rotten scholars and is full of benevolence and righteousness. Such a person... can be a scholar, but he will never be a good emperor.
How can an emperor be kind to women?
But if this is really related to the prince's teachings, it will inevitably make people look at him with admiration if the prince actually has such strategic vision.
Zhu Di waved his hand and said: "There is no need to continue to ask about this matter. If you ask about it again, it is inevitable that rumors of moving the capital will spread throughout the world. Now is not the time. I know these things, you know, and the prince knows it tacitly."
After saying that, Zhu Di couldn't help but show an angry face and said angrily: "I think the other disciples are all bastards. I'm looking for a few special bastards among them and punish them severely, especially that Zhang Fu. I won't break his legs on my behalf. It's hard to forgive!"
"Really?"
Zhu Di said with a straight face: "Hit!"
After the two of them agreed on their plan, Yao Guangxiao said coldly: "Has your Majesty forgotten that not long ago, your Majesty had a decree to issue an order... His Highness the Crown Prince..."
Zhu Di's face suddenly froze.
